description: Source-reviewed mesh-repair mutants for independent boundary limits and cancellation ownership. Repair.hpp is inline: rebuild every affected consumer before testing; frozen archives can mask changed definitions. Execution results are recorded separately.

mutants.description: Reject a hole whose total boundary count exactly equals the configured limit.
Reject a boundary cycle whose edge count exactly equals the configured hole limit.
Close a hole when only one of the two independent limits allows repair.
Leave a permitted tetrahedron boundary open.
Ignore cancellation at the final published stage and replace the caller-owned output.
